label: Berechiah

text.BHSA 1CH 15:22: וּכְנַנְיָ֥הוּ שַֽׂר־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמַשָּׂ֑א יָסֹר֙ בַּמַּשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י מֵבִ֖ין הֽוּא׃
text.KJV 1CH 15:22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
text.KJV 1CH 15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
text.BHSA 1CH 15:24: וּשְׁבַנְיָ֡הוּ וְיֹֽושָׁפָ֡ט וּנְתַנְאֵ֡ל וַעֲמָשַׂ֡י וּ֠זְכַרְיָהוּ וּבְנָיָ֤הוּ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מחצצרים בַּחֲצֹ֣צְרֹ֔ות לִפְנֵ֖י אֲרֹ֣ון הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וִֽיחִיָּ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֹֽון׃
text.KJV 1CH 15:24: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

B.name: Berechiah
B.notes: Gershonites (Gershomites), from Gershon, son of Levi
family: father-of asaph-2 (Asaph, son of Berechiah (1CH 6:39), chosen first by lot (1CH 25:9))

why: The Hebrew names Berechiah alongside Elkanah as an ark doorkeeper, without identifying his father or connecting him to Asaph. A separate Berechiah is therefore a tentative identification; these verses alone cannot exclude A or B.
